Tomorrow, I Will be Someone's Girlfriend
synopsis: "One time a week, I will be the girlfriend of [someone]." A bitter love story depicting the realities of love between female college students who earn money on behalf of her and men attracted by her. The first volume is a young office worker who rents the protagonist snow as a fake girlfriend, and draws a distorted love pattern of sota and snow. A substitute girl who plays the customer and the woman of their ideals to the end... Is the distance between two people's mind really close? Notes: - Winner of the 68th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shōjo Category - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? synonyms: Kunon The Sorcerer Can See Through
魔術師庫諾看得見一切
synopsis: Kunon Gurion, who was born blind, has one goal in life: finding a way to use his magic to see, something no one has ever done before. Luckily, Kunon's talent for magic leads him to quickly surpass his teacher. Before long, his name reaches even the royal palace, earning him the rare opportunity to study under a powerful mentor. (Source: Yen Press)

titleNative: お酒と先輩彼女との甘々同居ラブコメは二十歳になってから
synonyms: Sweet Cohabitation Romcom with My Senior Girlfriend and Alcohol Starts at Twenty
synopsis: “Don’t you think it’s about time we tried living together?” On my twentieth birthday, my girlfriend Momiji-senpai invites me to move in with her, and that’s how our life together begins. She loves alcohol, and once she starts drinking, she gets a little provocative… My self-control is already at its limit!! A sweet and slightly risqué cohabitation rom-com about a pure couple in love. (Source: Gangan Online)
